findings.title: ECS service with public IP assignment
findings.description: An aws_ecs_service whose network_configuration sets assign_public_ip = true exposes tasks directly to the internet. Services should run behind a load balancer in private subnets.
findings.remediation: Remove public exposure. Restrict ingress to known CIDR ranges, move the resource into private subnets, and front it with a load balancer or API gateway if external access is required. Verify with `aws ec2 describe-security-groups`.
